<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="vAnsAtp-NFmpoYSvQ_0c"> <mxGraphModel dx="1720" dy="940" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD

 A([Open Website])

 A --> B[Select Training]
 B --> C[Click \"Enroll Now\"]

 C --> D{Is User Authenticated?}

 %% Authentication Flow
 D -- Yes --> H[Training Registration Page]

 D -- No --> E[Create User Page]

 E --> F[Enter Full Name<br/>Email<br/>Password<br/>Mobile Number]

 F --> G{Validate Details?}

 G -- No --> G1[Show Validation Error]
 G1 --> F

 G -- Yes --> G2[Create User<br/>Role = Student]

 G2 --> G3{User Created?}

 G3 -- No --> G4[Show Error]
 G4 --> E

 G3 -- Yes --> H

 %% Training Registration
 H --> I[Prefill User Details]
 I --> J[Enter Remaining Registration Details]
 J --> K[Submit Registration]

 K --> L[Create Order]

 L --> M[Complete Payment]

 M --> N{Payment Successful?}

 N -- No --> O[Show Payment Error]
 O --> M

 N -- Yes --> P[Batch Reporting Page]

 %% Batch Reporting
 P --> Q[Click Complete Reporting]

 Q --> R[Select Technology]

 R --> S[Load Available Batches]

 S --> T[Select Preferred Batch]

 T --> U[Pay Remaining Training Fee]

 U --> V{Payment Successful?}

 V -- No --> W[Show Error with Retry Option]
 W --> U

 V -- Yes --> X[Student Dashboard]

 X --> Y([View All Training Details])",
 "config": null
